chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A group of people complained to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) about the rapid depletion of their food, so he said: 'Do you measure or heap?' They said: 'We heap, O Messenger of Allah' — meaning the rough estimate. He said: 'Measure and do not heap, for it is greater for the blessings.'

key_terms.تَهِيلُونَ: You heap (estimating roughly by volume without precise measuring)

ai.seo_question: Why does heaping food cause it to run out faster according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that 'heaping' (jizaf) refers to rough, imprecise measurement rather than mere abundance, linking ethical precision in trade directly to the preservation of divine barakah. This teaching underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on transparency and fairness in commercial transactions as a spiritual safeguard against resource depletion. It serves as a practical guideline for maintaining economic justice and spiritual well-being in daily dealings.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A group of people complained to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> of the rapid depletion of their foodstuffs, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Are you measuring out or heaping?’ They said, ‘We heap, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! – meaning the estimation. He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Measure out and do not heap, for it is greater for the Blessings’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya’qub, who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

A people complained before the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, against quick depletion of their food supplies. He (the Holy Prophet), asked, ’Do you measure or just dump?’ They replied, ’We just dump, O Messenger of Allah, that is, we do not measure.’ He (the Holy Prophet) said, ‘You must measure, you must not dump, measuring has greater blessings.’”
